basis: Existing v0.7 standalone 846-record editorial candidate inventory plus PR #923 source categories/locations; crosswalk remains provisional
directives: Categorise before full inventory; no map pins or coordinates in this pass
Sacred Geography and Bible Atlas are independent modules and acquisition pipelines
Do not count source rows as unique physical sites
Never add a second Place for an image, relic, grotto or within-site devotional feature
Do not treat 2025 Jubilee-stop designation as a permanent Catholic shrine or popularity certificate
Recognition by local bishop, episcopal conference and Holy See are different status levels; non-Vatican source is not Vatican recognition
Only identify exact physical site after local name/location/source verification
Do not bulk copy third-party descriptions, photos or licensed catalogues

source_pipeline.note: Philippines, Australia and gross worldwide index totals are separate source indexes, not new certified sites. They remain on original research PR for subsequent significance/physical-site decisions.
